text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.
WHEAT SALE - Mexico bought at least 27,000 to 36,000 tonnes U.S. hard red winter wheat. Shipment is expected to be in November and December.

CORN SALE - Taiwan's Members Feed Industry Group bought 54,000 tonnes of U.S. corn from Toepher Friday. The corn was bought at 87.80 cents over CBOT March. Shipment was slated for Jan 26-Feb 10 from the U.S. Gulf or Feb 11-25 from the Pacific Northwest (PNW).
COTTONSEED MEAL SALE - South Korea's National Livestock Cooperative Federation bought 30,000 tonnes of cottonseed meal.

CORN AND SOYBEAN TENDER - State-owned Taiwan Sugar Corp will tender Tuesday for 20,000 tonnes of U.S. corn and 10,000 soybeans. Shipment is for Nov 15-30 from the U.S. Gulf or Dec 1-15 from the PNW, or Nov 20-Dec 5 from the U.S. Gulf or Dec 5-20 from PNW.
CORN AND SOYBEAN TENDER - Taiwan may tender for up to 124,000 tonnes of corn and 156,000 tonnes of U.S. soybeans, possibly next week, export traders said.

CORN AND SOYBEAN TENDER - The Egyptian state's Food Industries Company said this week it extended until noon (1000 GMT) November 6 the deadline for bids for 30,000 tonnes U.S. or Argentine yellow corn and 30,000 tonnes of soybean, any origin. The old deadline was October 30.
CORN TENDER - South Korea's Korea Corn Processing Industry Association said Friday it passed on 52,500 tonnes of U.S. No.2 yellow corn.
- The Cyprus Grain Commission on Wednesday invited tenders to supply 18,000 tonnes of maize, with a shipment date of November or December. The tender closes November 5.
WHEAT TENDERS - The CCC will tender Nov 6 for up to 10,000 tonnes of northern spring wheat for donation to Ghana.
- CCC also seeks up to 1,600 tonnes of hard red winter wheat for donation to Benin. The wheat was slated for Dec 1-25 shipment.
- Pakistan seeks 200,000 tonnes of U.S. No. 2 or better soft white wheat for Nov 12-30. Bids will be opened Nov 3.
SOYOIL TENDER - The CCC is to tender Nov 6 for 13,000 tonnes of crude degummed soybean oil for donation to Peru. The oil was slated for Dec 14-30 delivery.

MARKET TALK - Philippine wheat importers are expected to scout for more bargains next week while feed millers are seen retreating to the sidelines after buying 150,000 tonnes of U.S. corn, Manila traders said... South Africa's Maize Board said on Friday it will offer up to 75,000 tonnes of white maize for domestic use or export during December. The tender will close on November 12, with the results expected the following day, the Board said in a statement.

MARKET TALK (cont.) - Mexican soybean imports in the 1996-97 cycle will likely be slightly higher than the estimated 2.7 million tonnes in the 1995-96 cycle, the American Soybean Association's local office said.
